notes: §1985:XIV.3.2.3 SR4: "Literal-1 or the content of the data item referenced by identifier-1 must be defined as alphanumeric." The DISABLE KEY operand is screened by the same CommunicationBinder#IsAlphanumericKey as ENABLE's (1985-SR-XIV.3.3.3-4), asked of the reference (kb/Work PB5384): DISABLE ... KEY K-NUM (3:) and K-EDT (2:2) are accepted at --std 85 on this tree (pb5384_key_refmod_85), a reference-modified PIC A item stays alphabetic and is refused, and the whole numeric, numeric edited and alphabetic items are refused as before. Open question carried from the read, not counted: PIC XXBXX (alphanumeric edited) is accepted while ZZ9.99 is refused.

next.reason: 1985: "Literal-1 or the content of the data item referenced by identifier-1 must be defined as alphanumeric."; 2023: "No DISABLE statement or Communication module in 2023; no candidate clause holds the feature". No 2023 clause holds the DISABLE statement. The wording candidates cover CANCEL, CALL, SEND, MOVE and others, not the DISABLE key operand, so the feature is dropped.
